description: Find artifacts of ANY one type across the catalog — the cross-type entry point. Each type also has a dedicated find_<type> tool (find_mcp, find_rules, find_scopes, …) with sorts and filters unique to that type; prefer those when you know the type. Types: mcp, skills, rules, arazzo, plans, rate-limits, finops, collections, asyncapis, graphql, json-ld, channels, examples, json-schemas, json-structures, openapis, postman, apis-json. PRO: scopes, security. include=["content"] inlines bodies.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

name: find_artifacts
